# seerr_radarr_server_test (Resource)

Test connection to a Radarr server via `/api/v1/settings/radarr/test`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "seerr_radarr_server_test" "example" {
  hostname = "127.0.0.1"
  port     = 7878
  api_key  = "your-radarr-api-key"
  use_ssl  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The API key for authenticating with the Radarr server.
- `hostname` (String) The hostname or IP address of the Radarr server.
- `port` (Number) The port number of the Radarr server.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) Whether to connect to the Radarr server using SSL/TLS (HTTPS).

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Optional URL path prefix for the Radarr server (e.g. `/radarr`).
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary map of values (such as timestamps or hashes) that, when changed, will re-trigger the connection test.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (formatted as `hostname:port` or `hostname:port/base_url`).
- `profiles_count` (Number) The number of quality profiles returned by the Radarr server upon successful connection test.
